passages.chinese: 安全第一。进入工地之前，你必须戴上安全帽。
passages.english: Safety comes first. You must wear a hard hat before entering the job site.
passages.tip: 两句都要说完整；注意 must 的重音。

passages.chinese: 请按书面顺序执行说明。不要跳过任何步骤。
passages.english: Follow the instructions in the order they are written. Do not skip any steps.
passages.tip: 第二句用 Don't 也可以，但请尽量说完整否定。

passages.chinese: 如果警报响起，立刻离开作业区，并报告给你的主管。
passages.english: If the alarm sounds, leave the work area immediately and report it to your supervisor.
passages.tip: 条件句 if 从句用现在时，主句用祈使语气。

passages.chinese: 切断电源，完成上锁，然后再打开配电箱。
passages.english: Turn off the power, complete the lockout, and then open the panel.
passages.tip: 三个动作按顺序：turn off, complete, open。

passages.chinese: 损坏的个人防护用品必须更换。千万不要继续使用。
passages.english: Damaged PPE must be replaced. Never keep using it.
passages.tip: PPE 按字母读：P-P-E。

passages.chinese: 在安装之前，先检查梯子是否放在坚实平整的地面上。
passages.english: Before you install the ladder, check that it is on firm, level ground.
passages.tip: firm 和 level 是两个并列形容词。

passages.chinese: 绝不要站在悬吊重物下面。坠落物可能造成重伤。
passages.english: Never stand under a suspended load. A falling object can cause a serious injury.
passages.tip: falling 是动名词/现在分词作定语。

passages.chinese: 英语 12 达到百分之五十，就可以满足第三类入学要求。
passages.english: English Studies 12 with 50 percent meets the Category 3 admission requirement.
passages.tip: Category 3 是专有说法，数字用 three。

passages.chinese: 如果你没有英语 12 成绩，也可以参加 BCIT 工科英语入学测评。
passages.english: If you do not have English 12, you can take the BCIT English Trades Entry Assessment.
passages.tip: Assessment 重音在第二音节。

passages.chinese: 同等的英语课程也可能被接受。请向招生办确认。
passages.english: An equivalent English course may also be accepted. Please confirm with admissions.
passages.tip: equivalent 有四个音节。

passages.chinese: 有力的论证需要一个清楚的主张，还需要相关的证据。
passages.english: A strong argument needs a clear claim and relevant evidence.
passages.tip: claim 和 evidence 是一对学术核心词。

passages.chinese: 动笔之前，先确保你真正理解了题目。
passages.english: Before you start writing, make sure you truly understand the question.
passages.tip: make sure 后面接完整从句。

passages.chinese: 虽然这个想法很有趣，但是它缺少证据。
passages.english: Although the idea is interesting, it lacks evidence.
passages.tip: although 不能和 but 连用。

passages.chinese: 把中心论点放在引言结尾，然后用段落去支撑它。
passages.english: Put your thesis at the end of the introduction, then support it with body paragraphs.
passages.tip: thesis 读作 /ˈθiːsɪs/。

passages.chinese: 要解释引文，而不只是把它抄进文章里。
passages.english: Interpret the quotation; do not just copy it into your essay.
passages.tip: interpret 重音在第二音节。

passages.chinese: 每一个段落都应该只展开一个中心意思。
passages.english: Each paragraph should develop only one controlling idea.
passages.tip: should 表示建议性要求。

passages.chinese: 根据评分标准，语法和连贯性仍然会影响分数。
passages.english: According to the rubric, grammar and coherence still affect the mark.
passages.tip: according to 后面接名词。

passages.chinese: 删除与中心论点无关的细节，文章会更连贯。
passages.english: Delete details that are not relevant to the thesis, and the essay will be more coherent.
passages.tip: relevant 和 coherent 都是学术高频形容词。

passages.chinese: 间隔重复的关键，是在快要忘记的时候再复习。
passages.english: The key to spaced repetition is to review just before you forget.
passages.tip: the key to 后面接名词或动名词。

passages.chinese: 不要把今天到期的卡片往后拖，否则你会落后。
passages.english: Do not put off the cards that are due today, or you will fall behind.
passages.tip: put off 和 fall behind 都是动词短语。

passages.chinese: 每天花二十分钟，把新内容和旧内容混在一起练习。
passages.english: Spend twenty minutes each day mixing new material with old review.
passages.tip: spend 的过去式是 spent；这里用原形祈使。

passages.chinese: 如果你不确定，就查阅术语表，并把新词写下来。
passages.english: If you are not sure, look up the term in the glossary and write it down.
passages.tip: look up 和 write down 是两个动词短语。

passages.chinese: 请提前十五分钟到场。迟到可能会失去考试座位。
passages.english: Please show up fifteen minutes early. If you are late, you may lose your test seat.
passages.tip: show up 表示到场；lose 的过去式是 lost。

passages.chinese: 向主管报告隐患时，说话要清楚、具体。
passages.english: When you report a hazard to your supervisor, speak clearly and be specific.
passages.tip: when 时间从句用现在时。

passages.chinese: 第一次车间课前，要买符合认证的安全鞋和护目镜。
passages.english: Before the first shop class, buy certified safety boots and safety glasses.
passages.tip: buy 的过去式是 bought，这里用原形。

passages.chinese: 即使伤得不重，也要把事情报告上去。
passages.english: Report it even if you are not badly hurt.
passages.tip: hurt 的过去式和过去分词都是 hurt。

passages.chinese: 结果泄漏是因为接头裂了，而不是阀门松了。
passages.english: The leak turned out to be a cracked fitting, not a loose valve.
passages.tip: turn out to be 表示“结果是”。

passages.chinese: 相比之下，工科测评更侧重说明书、安全和现场沟通。
passages.english: In contrast, the trades assessment focuses on instructions, safety, and workplace communication.
passages.tip: 三个名词用 and 连接，注意并列停顿。
